sections.title: 1. Scope
paragraphs: This Privacy Policy describes how LLRD may collect, use, disclose, protect, retain, and otherwise process personal information when individuals interact with our corporate website or other services that expressly link to this Privacy Policy.
This policy does not necessarily describe every processing activity of every LLRD product.
Products that process materially different categories of information should provide supplemental privacy notices.

sections.title: 2. PERSONAL INFORMATION
paragraphs: “Personal information” generally means information that identifies, relates to, describes, is reasonably capable of being associated with, or could reasonably be linked to an identified or identifiable individual, subject to definitions and exceptions under applicable law.

Information that has been lawfully de-identified, aggregated, or anonymized so that it cannot reasonably be associated with an identifiable individual may not constitute personal information under applicable law.

sections.title: 16. TENNESSEE PRIVACY
paragraphs: LLRD is organized in Tennessee and intends to maintain privacy practices consistent with applicable Tennessee requirements.

The Tennessee Information Protection Act (“TIPA”) applies only when its statutory applicability requirements and thresholds are satisfied. Among other requirements, the Act generally applies to persons conducting business in Tennessee or producing products or services targeted to Tennessee residents that exceed the statutory revenue threshold and meet specified consumer-data processing thresholds. LLRD's organization or location in Tennessee, by itself, does not mean that TIPA applies to every LLRD activity.
Where TIPA applies, qualifying Tennessee consumers may have rights that include the ability to:
confirm whether personal information is being processed;
obtain certain information in a portable format;
opt out of qualifying sales of personal information;
opt out of certain profiling; and
appeal certain decisions concerning privacy requests.

LLRD may voluntarily provide some privacy controls even where a particular statutory threshold has not been met. The availability of a voluntary control does not constitute a representation that a particular privacy statute applies to LLRD or to a particular processing activity.

sections.title: 20. NON-DISCRIMINATION

sections.title: 21. COOKIES
paragraphs: Current corporate website configuration: no advertising cookies, pixels, behavioral advertising or cross-site tracking are installed. A first-party sessionStorage value (llrd.discovery.seen.v1) remembers whether the discovery prompt was shown during this tab session. No operational analytics provider is configured.
LLRD websites may use cookies, local storage, pixels, SDKs, and similar technologies.
LLRD will identify and provide legally required controls if advertising or cross-context behavioral tracking technologies are introduced.

LLRD will seek to select and configure providers consistent with the sensitivity of the relevant information.

Corporate website AI is separate from product AI. Groq is the selected initial provider for future website testing; live requests are not enabled until server configuration is complete. When enabled, a submitted question and approved public website facts are sent to the configured provider. Do not include personal or sensitive information.

sections.title: 39. CHILDREN UNDER 13

sections.title: 43. GENETIC AND GENEALOGICAL INFORMATION
paragraphs: A genealogy or family-history service may involve information about:
genetic information if a future feature expressly supports such information.
Genealogical information can reveal information not only about the individual who submitted it but also about biological relatives.
Accordingly, LLRD will seek to apply heightened safeguards to sensitive genealogical and genetic information.
LLRD should not accept raw DNA data unless a specific product feature, privacy notice, security model, retention policy, and consent process have been established for that purpose.

sections.title: 44. BIOMETRIC INFORMATION
paragraphs: LLRD will not treat an ordinary photograph as a biometric identifier merely because it depicts a face.

If LLRD introduces facial recognition, voiceprints, fingerprints, iris scans, or another technology designed to identify individuals through biometric characteristics, the applicable product will provide appropriate notice and consent mechanisms required by applicable law.

sections.title: 45. HEALTH INFORMATION
paragraphs: An LLRD product may permit users to store, organize, understand, connect, or manage health-related information.

whether an organization is a HIPAA covered entity;
whether LLRD acts as a business associate;
whether the Federal Trade Commission's Health Breach Notification Rule applies;
whether state consumer-health-data or privacy laws apply; and

LLRD will not represent that all health information is “HIPAA protected.” Product-specific health notices will describe material privacy practices and legally required rights applicable to the relevant product.

sections.title: 46. HIPAA AND CONSUMER HEALTH DATA
paragraphs: HIPAA applies to covered entities and certain business associates.

If LLRD enters a relationship in which it legally becomes a business associate, LLRD will implement the applicable contractual, privacy, security, and breach-notification requirements associated with that role.
Where required, an appropriate Business Associate Agreement will be executed.

A consumer application handling health information is not necessarily subject to HIPAA merely because the information concerns health. Consumer health applications outside HIPAA may nevertheless be subject to the Federal Trade Commission Act, the FTC Health Breach Notification Rule, state privacy or consumer-health-data laws, and other applicable requirements.
Where the FTC Health Breach Notification Rule applies, LLRD will provide legally required notifications following a qualifying breach of unsecured personal health record information.

Address: 1109 Woodland St, Unit 60552, Nashville, TN 37206, United States

Where LLRD qualifies for and elects to rely upon applicable Digital Millennium Copyright Act safe-harbor provisions, LLRD will maintain the required designated-agent information with the U.S. Copyright Office and make the required contact information publicly available.

LLRD may remove or restrict access to material in response to a valid notice and may request additional information necessary to evaluate a complaint. Where applicable, users may have rights to submit a counter-notification under the DMCA.
